content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] with [article_no] and working with [product_name] [version_no]. When attempting to transfer a program from my computer to the device, I encounter the following error: "Interface specified not available. Please check: - Device connected in the correct mode - PC with device. - Correct interface selected". I've attached a screenshot of the error. Any assistance is appreciated.
Hi, are you sure you have [product_name] [version_no]? Or do you have [product_name] [version_no] and Windows 8?

Hello [user_name], please navigate to Tools > Options > Interface and check if the correct cable is selected. There is also an "Automatic detection" button for the interface. Additionally, review the FAQ: How can you connect [product_name] with a PC? Scrolling down in the FAQ, you'll find information about possible error messages and solutions. Also, go to Help > About in your [product_name] software to confirm the version, as you might have [product_name] [version_no] with Windows 8 as [user_name] previously mentioned. Hope this helps. Please update us if your issue is resolved. Greetings, [user_name]

I'm still unable to connect the device on Mac, but still trying. If anyone succeeds in getting a connection with a Mac, please share your experience. Thank you for your support. Keep up the good work!

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenges users faced were connecting their [product_name] device to the computer due to unclear software versioning, confusing interface and driver setup, and ambiguous error messages. There was difficulty verifying which software version was installed, ensuring required drivers were present, and selecting the correct interface options. Users needed step-by-step guidance to troubleshoot connection issues and confirm installation details.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and reliable process for connecting their device to a PC, with clear version identification and automatic interface recognition. They prefer minimal troubleshooting, straightforward driver installation, and clear instructions to ensure seamless setup.
